artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal typebars merge into an indistinct, tangled mesh rather than showing distinct, separate mechanical arms. This suggests AI generation failure in rendering complex repetitive mechanical structures.
The gold lettering/surfaces on the keys lack crisp edges and appear slightly 'melted' or smeared into the black keycaps, lacking the sharp definition of real typewriter keys.
The right-hand frame of the typewriter appears to warp slightly inward without a clear mechanical reason, deviating from the rigid straight lines expected in metal chassis construction.
